author: Janet viy

title: Quelle déception
body:
Au premier abord, lorsque j’ai appris qu’une application de James Clear pour suivre ses habitudes était disponible, j’étais vraiment content. 

On installe l’application gratuitement, c’est très joli (la seule raison de la deuxième étoile), mais l’application est inutile. 

Elle essai de faire ce que d’autres applications d’habitudes font, mais en moins bien, et beaucoup plus cher. 

La version gratuite ne permet de suivre qu’une habitude à la fois, et 6 pour la version payante. Honnêtement, allez voir ailleurs, économisez votre argent et appliquez la méthode qu’il y a dans le livre.
author: smtookmyname

title: No useful access without Monthly subscription
body:
At the beginning, I was so glad to get the app. I could get to key info (from the book) well organised. Perfect. I was recommended it to everyone around me and suddenly after 3-4weeks of use with access to all the mindset tips, daily lessons etc. Suddenly no more access at all to any of it ! What a disappointment!!! And the price to access it now… a joke : 20/month or 130/ year.
You buy the book once and you get all those info + you subscribe to his free newsletter and you get the extra info. 
Why should we pay the price of the book each month 🫣 doesn’t make sense at all.
Please re think the model.
Maybe at least a code system for all the people who already bought the book and could also get access to the info on the app? 
Such a shame to create a great tool and not giving access to the basics✨

title: motivation + support
body:
This is a great app, intuitive, easy to use, energizing on the surface level, and deep if you want to tap into its resources.
It helps you build efficient habits by providing both motivation when you need the extra push and support when you need the extra care.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: Vanasay

title: Simplicity at its best
body:
To use a quote from the man behind atomic habits: “
The highest level of mastery is simplicity. Most information is irrelevant and most effort is wasted, but only the expert knows what to ignore.” This App is truly a testament to this philosophy, and as the world expert on habit formation James Clear has created a simple but well thought out tool to help you stick to your habits, no matter how small they may be.
